refutation_explanation: For n = 0, |2n| = 0. For every nonnegative integer m, 3^m is at least 1, so 3^m + 1 is at least 2 and therefore cannot be at most 0. Thus no permitted m exists.
search_space: The singleton bounded space of candidate integers n = {0} was swept in fixed order. Its sole candidate was checked exactly; the nonexistence of m is certified for all nonnegative integers m by 3^m + 1 >= 2 > |2*0| = 0.
